source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of exception handling (PDF 60).

blocks.text: Exception handling woh tareeqa hai jis se program chalte waqt aane wali ghaltiyan (errors) sambhali jati hain. Ghalti aaye to program crash hone ki bajaye chalta reh sakta hai ya gracefully (araam se, theek tareeqe se) band ho sakta hai. Is se code zyada robust (mazboot) banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Program crash hone dene ki bajaye exceptions kyun sambhalein?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke program kaam ka message dikha sake, ghalti se sambhal sake ya saaf tareeqe se band ho, aur users ke liye zyada robust ho.

items: Exception handling: chalte program ki ghaltiyan sambhalna, crash se bachna.
